restaurantName: Gai by Darren Chin (Taman Tun Dr Ismail)
address: 26A Lorong Datuk Sulaiman 1, Taman Tun Dr Ismail, Kuala Lumpur, 60000, Malaysia
bio: Gai (Thai for chicken) delivers tasty northern Thai food to the people of KL. The restaurant embodies the spirit of family and dishes are best shared for a group. Don’t miss Papa Suwit's tom saeb oxtail stew; a spicy-sour broth that boasts intense flavour from a mix of vegetables and herbs. The signature free-range chicken is grilled with a secret family recipe that emits a pleasant, chargrilled aroma. There are several seafood options too, including the flower crab....
pageTitle: Gai by Darren Chin (Taman Tun Dr Ismail)
